U.S. – Protected Veteran Self-Identification. This employer is a Government contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Assistance Act of 1974, as amended (VEVRAA), which requires Government contractors to take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment protected veterans. For more information, call the U.S. Department of Labor's Veterans' Employment and Training Service (VETS).
